mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interaction ( interaction_id, case_id, journey_id, interaction_type, direction, channel, content_summary, outcome, initiator_id, initiator_role, initiator_display_name, produced_claim_ids, occurred_at, ended_at, source_hash, source_uri, source_version, recorded_at ) VALUES ( #{interactionId}, #{caseId}, #{journeyId}, #{type}, #{direction}, #{channel}, #{contentSummary}, #{outcome}, #{initiator.participantId}, #{initiator.role}, #{initiator.displayName}, #{producedClaimIds, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.UuidListJsonTypeHandler}, #{occurredAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{endedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{sourceHash}, COALESCE(#{sourceUri}, ''), COALESCE(#{sourceVersion}, ''), COALESCE(#{recordedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )

INSERT INTO interaction_participant (interaction_id, participant_id, participant_role, display_name) VALUES (#{interactionId}, #{participant.participantId}, #{participant.role}, #{participant.displayName})
mapper.select: SELECT interaction_id, case_id, journey_id, interaction_type, direction, channel, initiator_id, initiator_role, initiator_display_name, content_summary, produced_claim_ids, outcome, occurred_at, ended_at, source_hash, source_uri, source_version, recorded_at FROM interaction WHERE interaction_id = #{interactionId}

SELECT interaction_id, case_id, journey_id, interaction_type, direction, channel, initiator_id, initiator_role, initiator_display_name, content_summary, produced_claim_ids, outcome, occurred_at, ended_at, source_hash, source_uri, source_version, recorded_at FROM interaction WHERE case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
